Username: Foxcol
Date Banned: December 22
Reason: Ban Evasion (PerkyPiper)
Banned By: GrapeSmoothie (Senior Mod)

Reason why I should not be banned: 


First off, I want to start by saying I have been playing mc for a few years. Recently I worked a summer job as a camp counselor and attended college. I did not have time to play, but now that I am on Christmas break, I do have time so I came on Avicus to play Skywars. 

First off, this might sound nooby, but I am not sure what ban evasion is. Is it a supposed alt account? I have never been banned on Avicus (until today) and never had an alt account. I did make a name change from Calchus, to Foxcol. I have never been banned on Avicus before so I am genuinely confused. Since I was not home (due to working at a summer camp and living in a dorm) I don't know if my brother made an account and got banned on Avicus. He does have a few accounts and he does play Avicus often. However I didn't ask if he was ever banned and he is in bed right now so I can't ask. We both play on the same router when I am at home so maybe he was banned on a different account and now my IP shows up as the same. If you don't believe me about my brother playing Minecraft, you can Skype both him and I at the same time and we will go on our accounts. My neighbor is also addicted to minecraft and he also has used a hacked client. I know one time on an old server (World of Keralis), when he got banned, and they IP banned him, my brother and I were also banned from the server; even though we play in different houses, we are just next door neighbors. However, since I do not know what avoiding a ban is, (because I have never been banned on Avicus) I am unsure of what to put here and I hope my explanation was okay. I also don't know if PerkyPiper is the name of the supposed alt account. I will ask my brother and neighbor if they ever had an account named that, since I haven't played with them in a few months, they could have got a name change or something. Can someone help clear this up please, I enjoy playing skywars. Also I have a screenshot of the screen and the reason that I can post if the staff needs that. Please help. Thanks!

 ~Foxcol

He said  that he was banned on Avicus on an account called Vulcan_22 (or something like that) and was also responsible for the account of PerkyPiper which was his alt account of Vulcan_22. If there is any way to prove that I only own one account (Foxcol) through Mojang or anything I will gladly do it. And then he can prove that he owns the other accounts. If there is anything I can do, I will do it. You can also Skype us both at the same time and we will screenshare to prove that we are 2 completely different people that just use the same router. Thanks again!
